summary: After rebasing, update the PR with git push --force-with-lease, which retriggers tests; check results afterward.
questions: How do I push my rebased branch to update the PR?
Why do I need a force push after rebasing?

answer_card.title: Update the PR after rebasing
answer_card.answer_md:
Rebasing rewrites history, so force push:
```shell-session
$ git push --force-with-lease
```
This updates the PR and reruns tests; check the results afterward.
